newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, brokers said on Monday.
"The morning session was quiet and featureless. Nothing was done in the morning but we were looking around for fresh incentives," a local broker said.
"Prices in Tokyo were firmer on sporadic shortcovering prompted by yen's weakness against the dollar but there was no follow-through buying interest here," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 slipped 0.75 cent to 126.25 U.S. cents a kg.
February RSS1 fell 1.25 cents to 177.00 Singapore cents (US$1.26) a kg.
January TSR20 eased 0.25 cent to 171.25 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
